orchestration: one default measurement agent on gpt-5.6-sol high; no child agents or guardians; deterministic harness uses disposable local clones and makes no model or provider call
limitations: The first sanitized formatter used an incorrect field path and was retried; all eight positive-usage model calls remain in the baseline.
The controlled case is a successful read-only publisher measurement; external PR publication and merge were intentionally not performed.
The artifact classifier retains only serialized sanitized tool-output payload bytes, not prompt, source, command, or tool-output bodies.
Raw local rollout usage is not billed API cost or exact subscription-credit consumption.

modelRequest.limitation: The rollout does not expose model request-start timestamps.

firstToken.limitation: The rollout does not expose first streamed-token timestamps.

completion.limitation: Token-count events are response aggregates and cannot separate model queue, prefill, and completion latency.

toolDuration.method: sum of seven paired tool call-to-output event spans
toolDuration.limitation: This measures local call-to-output emission, not model latency.

approvalWait.method: absence of approval or guardian events in the controlled child rollout
approvalWait.limitation: This zero is specific to the read-only controlled case and is not a repository guarantee.

coordinationWait.method: two paired child-result question to parent-reply event spans
coordinationWait.limitation: The waits were caused by report-schema clarification and should remain visible in before-after comparisons.

activeWallExcludingUserIdle.method: task_started to task_complete event span with no end-user message inside the child task
activeWallExcludingUserIdle.limitation: This span includes 21471 ms of separately reported agent coordination wait.

implementation.method: first deterministic API invocation start through successful sanitized measurement output
implementation.limitation: This phase includes one failed formatter and one coordination clarification before the successful retry.

publication.method: final clean-status output through completed sanitized result
publication.limitation: This is result publication to the parent task, not an external PR publication.

merge.limitation: No branch or pull request was merged in this measurement-only case.

cleanup.method: final repository status call-to-output span after disposable-clone cleanup
cleanup.limitation: The deterministic harness removed its clones internally; this metric covers only the explicit final verification call.
